info.title: Ghost Fleet X API
info.description: Maritime change intelligence: investigation leads, never accusations.

get.description: Vessel detections for one month (default: latest), fetched live from Global Fishing Watch (cached on disk).
Vessels that switched AIS off in a period (default: the last 30 days), where it happened most, and labelled hypotheses.
Largest possible oil slicks in a period (default: the last 30 days), machine-detected on Sentinel-1 radar (SkyTruth Cerulean).
Apparent fishing inside no-take protected areas in a period. Built by scripts/ingest_sea.py; 503 until that has run.
Find a ship by name, MMSI, IMO or call sign (Global Fishing Watch vessel identity).
One ship in a period: its path through its recorded events, and where and when it stopped broadcasting.
Shipping-lane tile: AIS vessel presence for one month (default latest), drawn by Global Fishing Watch (disk-cached).

post.description: Reload the panel from disk after `scripts/ingest_real.py` has pulled new data. Safe to retry.
Pure computation, cached, no stored state: safe to retry.

distanceKm.title: Distancekm
distanceKm.description: Distance between the last position before and the first after the gap

statements.title: Statements
statements.description: What was observed, and labelled hypotheses about what might have happened

vesselId.title: Vesselid
vesselId.description: GFW vessel id: open /api/sea/vessels/{vesselId} for the ship's path

onLat.title: Onlat
onLat.description: Where the vessel started broadcasting again

likelyIntentional.title: Likelyintentional
likelyIntentional.description: False if GFW does not class the gap as switched off on purpose

total.title: Total
total.description: AIS-off events in the whole window

events.title: Events
events.description: Events that started in the last `recentDays` days

hotspots.title: Hotspots
hotspots.description: Places where AIS is switched off most often, over the whole window

turnOnClusters.title: Turnonclusters
turnOnClusters.description: Areas where multiple ships turned AIS back on at the same time and place

heat.title: Heat
heat.description: [lat, lon] of every event in the window, for a density layer

start.title: Start
start.description: First day of the period (events are selected by the day the gap began)

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True if the period held more events than are fetched (15,000)

source.title: Source
source.default: Global Fishing Watch events API (public-global-gaps-events), gaps classed as likely intentional

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Centroid latitude of the dark operational area

lon.title: Lon
lon.description: Centroid longitude of the dark operational area

enterLat.title: Enterlat
enterLat.description: Centroid latitude where vessels entered the area and switched AIS off

enterLon.title: Enterlon
enterLon.description: Centroid longitude where vessels entered the area and switched AIS off

exitLat.title: Exitlat
exitLat.description: Centroid latitude where vessels exited the area and switched AIS back on

exitLon.title: Exitlon
exitLon.description: Centroid longitude where vessels exited the area and switched AIS back on

sharedHours.title: Sharedhours
sharedHours.description: Hours vessels spent concurrently operating dark inside the area together

spanHours.title: Spanhours
spanHours.description: Time window across which vessels exited and restored AIS

coPresenceStart.title: Copresencestart
coPresenceStart.description: Exact UTC date and time when all vessels were concurrently dark in the area (start of overlap)

coPresenceEnd.title: Copresenceend
coPresenceEnd.description: Exact UTC date and time when all vessels were concurrently dark in the area (end of overlap)

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Exit latitude (where AIS was turned back on)

lon.title: Lon
lon.description: Exit longitude (where AIS was turned back on)

fetchedAt.title: Fetchedat
fetchedAt.description: UTC time this month was pulled from Global Fishing Watch

source.title: Source
source.default: Global Fishing Watch public-global-sar-presence (Sentinel-1 SAR), 0.1° bins

place.title: Place
place.description: Approximate sea name for the lead cell (reading aid, not a boundary)

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of the apparent change attributed to this explanation (0-1)

alertsByStep.title: Alertsbystep
alertsByStep.description: Cells each step would flag after FDR (naive vs corrected)

fetchedAt.title: Fetchedat
fetchedAt.description: UTC time the live data was pulled (null for demo data)

fullNoTake.title: Fullnotake
fullNoTake.description: True if the whole area is no-take; false if only part of it is

scanned.title: Scanned
scanned.description: Apparent-fishing events examined for those days

start.title: Start
start.description: Period filter applied to `events` (`days` lists every day that has been scanned)

source.title: Source
source.default: Global Fishing Watch events API (public-global-fishing-events) tagged inside no-take marine protected areas

totalMatched.title: Totalmatched
totalMatched.description: Slicks above the size and confidence floor in the window; the largest are returned

source.title: Source
source.default: SkyTruth Cerulean (machine-detected on Sentinel-1 radar; not verified by a person)

pctPerYear.title: Pctperyear
pctPerYear.description: Sen's slope ×12 as % of reference level

transmitsFrom.title: Transmitsfrom
transmitsFrom.description: First AIS transmission GFW holds for this ship

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the ship was recorded doing. The stretch from a gap_off point to the next gap_on point was sailed unseen

label.title: Label
label.description: Port name, or the other vessel in an encounter

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True if the ship had more events in the period than are fetched (3,000)

points.title: Points
points.description: The ship's recorded events in time order. Joined up, they are its path

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: Every time it stopped broadcasting in the period: where, when, for how long, and where it reappeared

source.title: Source
source.default: Global Fishing Watch vessel identity and events APIs. Raw AIS tracks are not part of the free data.

q.title: Q
q.description: BH-FDR q-value across all cells for this step
